endorsements.name: Lorenzo Franchini
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-14399
endorsements.description: The Download Plugins and Themes in ZIP from Dashboard plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery in all versions up to, and including, 1.9.6. This is due to missing or incorrect nonce validation on the download_plugin_bulk and download_theme_bulk functions. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to archive all the sites plugins and themes and place them in the `wp-content/uploads/` directory via a forged request granted they can trick a site administrator into performing an action such as clicking on a link.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.3)

endorsements.name: Lorenzo Franchini
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-14478
endorsements.description: The Demo Importer Plus plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to XML External Entity Injection (XXE) in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.9 via the SVG file upload functionality. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Author-level access and above, to achieve code execution in vulnerable configurations. This only impacts sites on versions of PHP older than 8.0.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.5)
